pretreatments.description: Mechanical degradation: maize straw was chopped into small pieces of 5-8 cm using a manual chopper and then ground with a FZ-102 Mini Plant Grinder to obtain powder with particle size less than 2 mm.

Biological pretreatment: addition of 50 mL crude enzyme solution (mixed enzymes secreted by Trichoderma viride and Aspergillus sp. in various mixing ratios of ETv/EAs: 5/0, 4/1, 3/2, 2/3, 1/4, 0/5) to 9 g of dry maize straw powder, incubated at 50 °C for 6 days.
